Why Non-Operated

Own the Upside. Skip the Operations.

Working-interest participation, structured for investors who want direct exposure to Permian production economics — without running field operations themselves.

Institutional Access Without Operating a Well

You participate directly in working-interest economics alongside major operators — with none of the field staffing, permitting, or day-to-day operating burden.

Independent Engineering Underwriting

Every well is underwritten using the MIDAS methodology — an independent reservoir-engineering standard that grounds projections in production data, not promotional estimates.

Diversified Across Five Projects, Four Operators

Your capital is spread across five development projects run by four different institutional operators — reducing single-well and single-operator concentration risk.

"Direct working-interest exposure, underwritten to institutional standards — without ever touching an operating decision."

Dalton J. Ortiz — Founder & Managing Partner, Warrior Race Investments

Where We Drill

Midland & Delaware Basins, Texas

WRI Permian 1 concentrates capital in proven development counties across two of the most active basins in North America — operated by five of the industry's most disciplined institutional operators.

ConocoPhillips Mewbourne Exxon (XTO) Pioneer SM Energy / Civitas
